last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 9
last_episode_to_air.overview: The news that the dormitory will be closed turns Aras and his friends' lives upside down. Aras finds himself torn between the most important search of his life and his friends' futures. Aras and his friends, refusing to leave the dormitory, decide to spend the night in the dormitory's garden. In this struggle of Aras, his biggest supporters will be Barış and Özlem. However, an unexpected name joins this event: Teoman. Teoman finds himself in the midst of a tension he never anticipated. This tension will cause Teoman to lose control over his suppressed emotions. Leyla becomes the target of the dormitory children's anger. The children, blaming the Akkayalar for what happened to Aras, don't want to let Leyla into their midst. Aras tries to keep Leyla away from himself to protect her. Every step Aras takes to protect her will only deepen Leyla's resentment toward Aras. Right at that moment, a sentence that Leyla overhears will change all the balances regarding Aras's true feelings.

name: Torn Apart
overview: Aras, a fearless seventeen-year-old boy, comes to Bodrum to search for his younger sibling, the only remaining member of his family whom he lost at the age of five. His new life in Bodrum will turn into a challenging struggle when his path crosses with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in the city.
